items.title: Jose Alvarado Out Friday With Ankle Injury
items.summary: Jose Alvarado is set to miss the New York Knicks' NBA Cup matchup against the Philadelphia 76ers on Friday due to a right ankle injury. Alvarado will now miss four straight games with the injury. Head coach Mike Brown did not indicate that it would be a long-term issue when discussing the injury on Tuesday. The Knicks are 2-3 on the season heading into Friday.

items.title: Knicks To Decline Pacome Dadiet's Fourth-Year Option
items.summary: The New York Knicks will decline Pacome Dadiet's fourth-year option worth $5.37 million, sources told Shams Charania of ESPN. Dadiet is set to become an unrestricted free agent in June. Dadiet averaged 1.7 points in 29 games last season. The 21-year-old has played just one minute this year.

items.title: Ex-Laker Dalton Knecht joins Knicks on two-way contract
items.summary: Former Lakers first-round pick Dalton Knecht has agreed to a two-way deal with the Knicks, his agents told ESPN's Shams Charania.
